$comment: Accessibility notes for the 14 core patterns (Storybook Patterns/*), written with their use-guidelines on 2026-10-23. Hand-off for extending the matrix (build-a11y.mjs) to blocks: one entry per pattern, each a WCAG criterion with a finding. Source is code reading, not a test or a screen-reader pass, so treat result as 'expected' until a review confirms it. result: pass | fail. The reader-facing version of the same notes is in each <block>.guidelines.tsx (a11y).

AccessTokens.finding: Revoke opens a ConfirmDialog and the toast offers undo; a revoked key can be restored.
The new key is shown once in a dialog inside a SecretField with its own named Copy button.

AuditLog.finding: Event category is a word in a Badge plus an icon chip, not color alone.
The empty state tells 'nothing matches the filters' from 'no events yet'.

BillingUsage.finding: Invoice status is a StatusDot with a text label; quota fullness is given as numbers and percent, not only by the bar.
Plan, usage and invoices are headed sections.

DashboardOverview.finding: 'Needs attention' is first in DOM order, not only placed first visually.
Usage is stated in numbers and percent; the chart and bars repeat the text.

Details.finding: Status is a dot with a word.
The resource title is the page heading; an id or domain in it is set in monospace.

ListView.finding: Destructive row and bulk actions confirm first and offer undo in the toast.
The DataTable stacks rows into items below 640px instead of scrolling sideways.

LoginForm.finding: Empty or malformed email and an empty password show errors on the fields, focus the first invalid field and block onSubmit.

LoginFormSplit.finding: The image carousel autoplays every 6s by default (autoplayInterval = 6000) and loops indefinitely, with no pause control and no prefers-reduced-motion check (login-form-split.tsx, the setInterval effect). Needs a pause/stop control or no autoplay by default, and should stop under reduced motion.
Below md the image panel is dropped and only the form remains.

NotificationsInbox.finding: Unread rows differ visually and announce 'Unread'.
The whole row is one interactive control; its actions menu is a separate control in the trailing slot.

OnboardingWizard.finding: Root is role="group" labelled by the wizard heading; the Stepper marks the current step.
Inactive steps are hidden, not unmounted, so Back returns to what was entered.

Preferences.finding: The section nav sets aria-current on the section in view.
Deleting the account requires typing the account email in a ConfirmDialog.

ResourceForm.finding: One error moves focus to its field; several move focus to an error summary (Alert, live=assertive) that links to each field.
Errors are tied to their fields and set the field's own danger state (error prop), not only the text below.

TeamMembers.finding: Roles are words in Badges and Selects.
Remove member and revoke invite confirm first and offer undo in the toast.

WorkspaceLayout.finding: A skip link is the first Tab stop and jumps to the content.
Below md the sidebar is a slide-over panel; a long identifier crumb doesn't make the page scroll at 360px.
